meaning: Current evidence-backed acceptance record. Historical evidence is retained; a component PASS does not grant full browser, recovery or production acceptance.

G2_v07_copy_upgrade_and_restore.reason: The Windows host was reset and no v0.7 database backup was supplied. Source migration is not recovery of that database.

G4_public_deployment.reason: Temporary Mac course demo accepted for bounded HTTPS/browser, service restart, same-Mac restore and measured read-only course capacity/stability. Earlier tunnel reconnect failures are retained; off-host loss recovery, whole-host reboot, write/large-dataset capacity and continuous availability remain unestablished.

temporary_mac_https_and_browser.scope: 7 public HTTPS checks and 43 real Chromium checks; business facts unchanged

private_backup_and_separate_empty_restor.scope: Same-Mac independent PostgreSQL restore, runtime role and normal backend login with CSRF

independent_external_network_probe.scope: 7 verified HTTPS checks from the GitHub-hosted external runner

demo_web_and_gateway_restart.scope: Same-Mac service restart; original volume preserved and public HTTPS rechecked

demo_operations_status_and_login_links.scope: Controlled Mac CLI/HTTP failure rehearsal and private login-link refresh; live origin and public HTTPS rechecked without restarting the public tunnel

demo_capacity_and_stability.scope: Small synthetic read-only dataset: origin ramp to 20 users/20 GETs per second, explicit 40 GETs per second overload and recovery; repeated public 10-user/10 GETs per second 600-second run: 6,000/6,000 successes, p95 565.652 ms; no sampled OOM/restart/DB wait; business facts unchanged

continuous_public_availability.scope: The first public soak and a later preflight failed during tunnel reconnects; a subsequent successful ten-minute window is bounded evidence only

blockers: Temporary Mac demonstration does not establish off-host recovery, whole-host reboot, write/large-dataset capacity or continuous target availability
